about.missionLead: Art Bloc gives emerging artists a space through temporary exhibitions in Montreal.
about.missionBody: Our mission is to lower the barriers to the art world for emerging artists and give them visibility. By offering an accessible exhibition space, the project aims to democratize local art and build connections within the cultural scene.
about.historyBody: Our commitment to nurturing creativity. Art Bloc was born in October 2024 from a simple but striking observation: many young artists gradually give up their practice under the weight of other responsibilities. Where musicians have open mics, artists will have Art Bloc.
